description: This file implements a Neo4j writer service class that manages connections, schema setup, and data writing operations for article and chunk entities in a Neo4j database. It includes functions for hashing chunk IDs, schema initialization, and methods to write articles with associated chunks and optional embeddings, handling exceptions and logging throughout.
